subject: Alignment Summit: consolidated action digest + exec asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Cross-functional Sync <crossfunc@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>; Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 09 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment Summit: consolidated action digest + exec asks

Team — thanks again for the Alignment Summit yesterday. I captured the open commitments and consolidated the exec asks into a single sheet so we can track ownership and due dates. Key asks to highlight for QBR prep:

- Exec ask #1: Finalize Dedicated launch SLO language for APAC customers (owner: Jonas).
- Exec ask #2: Pricing carve-outs for reserved capacity (owner: Vivek).
- Exec ask #3: Confirm SOC2 evidence owners for Dedicated and Private (owner: Lauren).

Attached is a starter workbook with three tabs: ExecAsks, OpenDecisions, and Dependencies. Please do the following by EOD Monday:

1) Update the ExecAsks tab with owner comments + ETA.
2) Add any missing downstream dependencies on the Dependencies tab.
3) Flag any items that need legal/procurement involvement.

I created a quick prioritization proposal in the ExecAsks sheet based on risk and customer impact — feel free to push back, but mark your changes so we can roll them into the QBR narrative.

Attachments: QBR_exec_asks.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Cross-functional Sync <crossfunc@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment Summit: consolidated action digest + exec asks

Thanks Marissa — skimmed the sheet and added high-level notes to ExecAsks. Quick updates:

- Pricing carve-outs: I agree with the priority; provisional recommendation is to include a 10% discount band for committed Dedicated capacity for >12-month deals. I put that as proposal A in the sheet. Need finance to model P&L impact.
- Procurement loop: I flagged two items that will require procurement (data residency addendum + custom SLA).

Open question for the group: can engineering commit to a soft SLO for APAC by June 15? If not, we should include a mitigation (regional fallback to hosted). Jonas — can you confirm feasibility?

Also propose we create a one-page exec summary (not the full deck) that highlights the three prioritized asks and recommended owner/ETA. I can take the draft and iterate with Marissa.

-Vivek

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2027 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment Summit: consolidated action digest + exec asks

Marissa/Vivek — I updated the ExecAsks tab with SOC2 evidence owners and added comments where I think we need compliance support. Notes:

- Evidence owner (Dedicated): Lauren B. — will coordinate with security to fingerprint the control owners by 5/16.
- Evidence owner (Private): Product delivery lead (TBD) — added a placeholder and asked CS to confirm.
- For APAC SLOs: engineering needs to confirm latency targets and whether we can commit to a 99.5% p99 for the initial GA. If we cannot, legal wants explicit language in the contract about migration windows.

I've attached an updated alignment deck (alignment-deck-v2.pdf) with a one-page executive summary. Marissa — fine for me to share the summary with Sarah at Acme in case procurement asks for a copy during the evaluation?

Attachments: alignment-deck-v2.pdf

--
Lauren Bishop
VP, Product, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment Summit: consolidated action digest + exec asks

Hi Marissa & Lauren — thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. The one-page executive summary is perfect for procurement — please go ahead and share. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- Procurement would like to see the draft SLO language referenced in the ExecAsks tab so they can start redlining contract language.
- Can you confirm whether the Dedicated APAC rollout will require any additional onboarding lead time beyond the 8-week estimate?

We'll aim to have initial redlines back by May 19. If you can put the SLO draft into the sheet (or drop a link to it), that will speed things up.

Best,
Sarah Jennings
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Corp
